newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 27.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - June 27.

text.p: -- AT&T Corp's talks to merge with SBC Communications Inc in a $50 billion deal appear to be coming apart, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The newspaper said the deal was apparently unraveling due to concerns about opposition from federal regulators, the legal difficulties of getting SBC into the long-distance business, and disarray at AT&T. AT&T's stock closed at 36-1/8 Thursday while SBC finished at 60-1/8.

-- Intel Corp and Digital Equipment Corp are in talks to settle Digital's patent-infringement lawsuit against Intel, the Wall Street Journal reported. Intel closed at 143-11/16 and Digital closed at 35-9/16.
-- NationsBank Corp is close to announcing it will buy investment bank Montgomery Securities Inc for around $1 billion, financial cable television channel CNBC reported. NationsBank closed at 66-1/8.
-- Swiss insurance firm Zurich Group and Scudder, Stevens & Clark Inc said they had a definitive agreement to form a global investment firm in a deal valued at more than $2 billion.

-- S3 Inc said it expects second quarter revenues of $108 million, plus or minus two percent. It said pricing remained competitive in both two-dimensional and three-dimensional graphics. S3 closed at 10, then dipped to 9-5/8 in after-hours trading.
